finding.counterexample: After a valid 20-photo request committed with a lost reply, changing the live form to 0 or 21 photos disabled or preflight-rejected ordinary submit, so the modal could not reach the operation readback promised by its retry guidance.

implementation.operation_readback: ReviewSaveOperation.confirmPending() reads only the retained owner/id/upload snapshot. It never prepares, uploads, inserts, or treats an absent readback as rollback.
implementation.operation_gate: hasPendingConfirmation() exposes only retained unknown/saved writes, so ordinary upload uncertainty keeps its existing same-operation retry behavior.
implementation.cancel_latch: A completed blocked cancel latch is cleared for read-only confirmation; an active operation still blocks concurrent confirmation.
implementation.modal_action: Blocked commit results show a compact Save result check action independent of current photo count, readiness, and OCR state.
implementation.known_saved_flow: A confirmed original commit enters the existing saved-previous draft cleanup and input-preservation flow.
implementation.draft_cleanup: Draft cleanup has its own action independent of 0/21-photo form validity.
implementation.async_fences: Owner, close request, and mount state are checked after confirmation and after draft cleanup before modal state or toast writes.
implementation.ui: Result-check and draft-cleanup actions are 44px high below sm and retain the compact 32px height at sm and above.
